# Eastbright Global

> Eastbright Global is a cross-border marketing agency focused on AI, SaaS and tech brands, helping them expand into international markets through localised marketing strategy, content marketing and creator partnerships. The team is based in Taiwan and Kuala Lumpur and serves Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia.

The website is available in Traditional Chinese (default) and English. Client names, results and methods are not published; they are discussed during a consultation. Project and retainer fees are quoted by scope.

## Services

- [Market Strategy Diagnostic](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-1): competitor analysis, market selection and feasibility, positioning and local messaging strategy (市場策略診斷)
- [Social & Content Marketing](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-2): Threads, Xiaohongshu (RED), Facebook, Instagram and TikTok community management, word-of-mouth, social listening and PR (海外整合行銷)
- [Meta / Google Advertising](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-3): ad strategy, budget allocation, audience setup, creative testing, conversion tracking and reporting (Meta／Google 廣告投放)
- [Creator Partnerships](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-4): screening and matching expert and tech creators (KOLs/KOCs), campaign planning, affiliate programmes and tracking (海外 KOL/KOC 網紅合作)
- [AI Enablement](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#ai): marketing workflow diagnostic, AI collaboration and review process, brand knowledge base, in-house training and adoption support (AI 企業賦能)

## Starter offer

- [Brand Check](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#diagnostic): USD 300, delivered in 7 working days. Covers market strategy and priority recommendations, competitor messaging, localisation risks, a recommended next step, red flags and a live online debrief. Fully credited towards a first project started within three months. (跨境品牌檢測)

## Markets

- Taiwan (GMT+8)
- Hong Kong and Macau (GMT+8)
- Southeast Asia, with a team in Kuala Lumpur (GMT+7 / +8)
- Multi-market coordination across the region

## Team

- Yvonne Wang: Co-Founder, Growth Marketing Consultant, based in Taiwan
- S Wang: Co-Founder, Cross-Border Market Consultant, based in Kuala Lumpur

(Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.en.md)
- [外國品牌進入台灣市場，該從哪裡開始？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.html): 先確認台灣是不是現階段該進的市場，再依台灣的語言、平台與標示規定做在地化，小規模測試後才放大預算。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.zh.md)

- [進入港澳市場，和進入台灣有什麼不同？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.html): 港澳與台灣都使用繁體中文，但正式語文、主流平台與市場規模都不同。本文整理品牌進入港澳時需要調整的地方。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.zh.md)

Here is where the line sits. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.en.md)
- [跨境行銷，什麼能沿用到新市場、什麼必須重做？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.html): 產品的價值主張通常能跨市場沿用，溝通語彙、通路與創作者則幾乎都要重做。本文說明兩者的界線在哪裡。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.zh.md)
- [Going Global: Which Asian Market Should a Brand Enter First?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/which-asian-market-first.html): The right first market in Asia is the one where demand, price, channels and your ability to operate line up, not the biggest one. Here is how to rank the options. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/which-asian-market-first.en.md)
- [品牌出海，該先進哪一個亞洲市場？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/which-asian-market-first.html): 亞洲第一個市場該選的是需求、價格、通路與營運能力都對得上的市場，而不是規模最大的市場。本文整理比較方式與判斷條件。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/which-asian-market-first.zh.md)
